name: Cinnamon Buns Fast
ingredients: as needed - Cinnamon and Brown Sugar
instructions: Add milk and stir, the dough will be dry
Dump onto counter and knead gently until soft
Roll into rectangle, 15-18 inches by 8-10 inches
Smear a thin layer of softened butter leaving ~1/2 inch clear of butter for closing the rolls
Sprinkle cinnamon and brown sugar over the butter, too much cinnamon doesn't do good things
Roll the dough towards you, tightly at first, then loosen off.
Once rolled, use hands to even the log out.
Cut into quarters, then cut each quarter into thirds
Bake for 11 minutes in muffin tin
